IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_BatteryFailed: Couldn't change the battery: the watch or battery isn't on you.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_NoBatteryToRemove: There's no battery in the watch.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_OneWatchOnly: You can only wear one map watch. Take the other one off first.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_TwoWorn: You're wearing two map watches. Only the one on your left wrist works; take the other one off.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ApiMissing: Map Watch is not active: the MiniMap mod is too old, so the minimap stays open. Please update the MiniMap mod.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ShareApiMissing: Comm range is not active: the MiniMap mod is too old, so faction sharing has no distance limit. Please update the MiniMap mod.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_Off: The server has disabled the minimap
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_NoWatch: Wear a map watch to use the minimap
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_NoBattery: The map watch has no battery
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_Dead: The map watch battery is dead
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Status_NoBattery: No battery: insert one to restore it
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Status_Dead: Battery dead: insert a fresh battery to restore it
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_FeatureOff: The server has disabled this feature
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_NeedWatch: Wear a map watch to use this
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Reason_Need_mildet: The world map requires the Military Detector Module
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleFailed: Couldn't install or remove: the watch or module isn't on you.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_NeedScrewdriver: You need a screwdriver to install or remove modules.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_SlotFull: This slot already has a module. Remove it first to swap.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_SlotWrongClass: This slot can't take this type of module.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_UnlockFailed: Can't use the unlock card: this slot isn't opened with unlock cards, or the card isn't on you.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_AlreadyUnlocked: This slot is already open. The unlock card was not used.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_UnlockNoAccount: Can't use the unlock card: this character's account can't be verified (split-screen players 2-4 can't use them).
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_ledger: Shows resource points like gun stores and pharmacies on the map, with a legend. Searching points by category doesn't need a module.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_gps: Road navigation, multi-stop trips, and one-click route home. When a target is off-screen, shows a direction arrow and the remaining distance at the edge of the minimap. Your own coordinates don't need a module.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_comm: Share targets with your faction and see teammates on the map.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_scan: Shows nearby vehicles and animals on the minimap and world map.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_detect: Marks nearby zombies on the minimap and shows zombie heat. How often it updates depends on the server's scan settings.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_mildete: Doubles the detection radius, and shows zombie positions and heat on the world map too.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_longcom: Faction sharing and teammate icons. Can replace the Comms Module.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_relay: Faction sharing and teammate icons. Can replace the Comms Module.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_eco: Halves the whole watch's power drain, doubling battery life.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ShareRange: %1 Sharing range: %2 tiles. Both the sharer and the recipient need a comms module; the larger of their two ranges applies.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ShareRangeUnlimite: %1 When either the sharer or the recipient has a Relay Core, faction sharing has no distance limit (both still need a comms module).
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_Core: The Relay Core and Power-Saver Core can only go here.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_Addon: This slot was added by another mod.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_Orphan: The mod that added this slot has been removed: the module is paused and draws no power. You can still take it out; when the mod is back, the slot and its unlock come back too.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_Empty: Drag a module from your inventory here, press a module button below, or right-click a module and choose "Install to Map Watch". Takes about 3 seconds and needs a screwdriver; moving cancels it and the module stays in your inventory.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_Card: This server opens slots with unlock cards. Use one %1 to open the %2 permanently. It's tied to your account, so it still counts when you wear a different map watch.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_CardOpened: Opened with an unlock card. It's tied to your account, so it still counts when you wear a different map watch.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_Paused: The %1 isn't open, so this module is disabled and uses no power. It's still on the watch; you can remove it and install it in another working slot.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Desc_Dead: The battery is dead, so this module is paused.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayReason_UNKNOWN_: This slot isn't for sale right now.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayReason_MODE_NOT: This server doesn't sell this slot through the economy.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayReason_HAVE_PER: You already own this slot, so there's no need to rent it.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayReason_RENTING_: Your rental has auto-renew on. Turn it off before buying the slot.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayReason_READ_FAI: Couldn't read your purchases right now. Please try again later.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Drop_Lapsed: The rental for the %1 has ended. Renew it before installing.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayNoEcon: The server has no economy system, so this slot uses unlock cards for now.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayNoClient: Your Economy mod is too old to pay here. Whether the slot works is still decided by the server.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayAccountBound: It's tied to your account, so it still counts when you wear a different map watch.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayNotSold: This server isn't selling the %1 right now.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayNoBuy: This server doesn't sell it outright.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayBuyAutoOn: Auto-renew is on for your rental. Turn it off before buying the slot.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayBought: You own this slot. It's yours for good.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayAutoOff: Auto-renew is off: the slot stops working the moment the rental ends.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayNeedConsent: The rent, currency or period changed, so auto-renew is paused. Press "Accept New Terms" to keep it going.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayAutoPaused: Auto-renew is paused: the server has stopped rentals or can't charge right now.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayLapsed: The rental has ended: renew it before installing a module.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayLapsedModule: The rental has ended, so the %1 is disabled. It's still on the watch; you can remove it and install it in another working slot.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayFailFunds: Auto-renew couldn't charge you (not enough %1, %2 short).
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayRetryWindow: It retries every hour for the next %1 and turns the slot back on once it's paid.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayRenewToRestore: Renew to turn it back on right away.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayFrozen: The mod that added this slot was removed, so the rental is frozen: no rent is charged, %1 is left, and it continues when the mod is back.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayNoAnswer: The server didn't answer, so the payment result is unknown. Press "Check Purchase" to find out; you won't be charged twice.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayQuoteNoAnswer: The server didn't answer, and nothing was paid. Please try again.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayDuplicate: That was already paid; you weren't charged twice.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayNoOrder: That payment didn't go through. You can buy again.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayPaidAutoFailed: Paid, but auto-renew wasn't turned on: %1
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayAutoUnknown: The server didn't answer, so it's unclear whether auto-renew changed. Reopen the panel later to check.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayPriceChanged: The price just changed and the new price is shown above. Check it, then press "Pay" again.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PaySheetAuto: When it ends, %1 is taken from your wallet for another %2 days. If that fails it retries every hour for up to %3 hours, and the slot is off meanwhile. You can cancel any time.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_BannerRetry: The rental for the %1 has ended and the %2 is disabled; auto-renew keeps retrying for %3.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PlanTermsChanged: The %1's rent, currency or period changed: players with auto-renew must accept again before they're charged.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_DrainHalf: None; halves the whole watch's drain
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_BusyInstall: Installing %1 into %2. Takes about 3 seconds; moving cancels it and the module stays in your inventory.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_BusyRemove: Removing %1 from %2. Takes about 3 seconds; moving cancels it and the module stays on the watch.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Drop_Full: The %1 already holds the %2. Remove it first to swap.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Drop_Class: The %1 is a %2-class module; the %3 only accepts %4 modules.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Foot_Charge: Battery %1%%, about %2 left (real time; about %3 on a full battery)
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Foot_ChargeUnderHo: Battery %1%%, under 1 hour left (real time; about %2 on a full battery)
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Foot_NoBattery: No battery: insert one to restore it.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Foot_Dead: No power: insert a battery to restore it.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Banner_NotWorn: This watch isn't being worn: modules only work while it's on your wrist.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Banner_NoBattery: No battery: the minimap shows "No Signal" and all modules are stopped. Insert a battery to restore it.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Banner_Dead: Battery dead: the minimap shows "No Signal" and all modules are stopped. Insert a battery to restore it.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_NoModuleToInstall: No modules in your inventory fit this slot
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ModuleDesc_light: A light on your watch: when on, it lights up about %1 tiles around you, and nearby players who can see you see it too (same as a vanilla flashlight). No drain while off.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_LightFailed: Couldn't turn on the light: the Light Module isn't working or the watch has no charge.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_UiTooOld: The Map Watch panel needs a newer Minidoracat UI framework (API rev 14 or later). Please update the UI framework.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Foot_ChargingCar: Charging in the car, full in about %2. %1
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Foot_ChargingHouse: Charging in a powered building, full in about %2. %1
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Open_tooltip: Adjust map watch feature rules, slots and prices, battery, how watches are obtained, and zombie drops. Only admins can see this.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_UiMissing: The UI framework is too old to open Map Watch Settings.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Enable_desc: When on, players must wear a map watch to use the features set below. When off, nothing changes: no feature needs a watch.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Presets_desc: Pick a starting point. After applying it, you can still adjust each item in every category.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Preset_easy_: Only the minimap needs a watch; other features don't. Paid slots become free. Battery lasts 7 days, and the minimap stays on when it's dead.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Preset_stand: Each feature needs its own module. Paid slots follow "Slots & Prices". Battery lasts 3 days.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Preset_hard_: Every feature needs a module. Paid slots follow "Slots & Prices". Battery lasts only 1 day.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_PresetApplie: Applied the "%1" preset. Press "Review & Apply" to make it take effect.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Sum_Disabled: Map Watch: disabled. Every feature works as it does now, no watch needed
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Mode_noEcon: No economy installed, so unlock cards are used for now
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Mode_rentBuy: Rent %2 %3 per %1 days, or buy for %4 %3
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Mode_none: Economy, but neither buying nor renting is allowed
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Sum_Battery: Battery: about %1 hours on a full charge (real time), %2, %3
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Charge_car: full in about %1 hours in a vehicle
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Charge_house: full in about %1 hours in a powered building
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Charge_both: full in about %1 hours in a vehicle, or about %2 hours in a powered building
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Sum_LootAll: Loot: all %1 map watch styles appear
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Sum_Drops: Zombie drops: %1 rules, up to %2 items per zombie
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Features_des: Pick how each feature is unlocked. Players see which module is missing on the watch panel.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_ScanNote: Scan frequency (how often zombies, vehicles and animals are rescanned) is a sandbox option of the main MiniMap mod. It applies server-wide and isn't set in this window.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Ranges_desc: The actual range never exceeds the server's view distance limit. Admins using Tactical view aren't limited by these.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Slots_desc: Every watch has 3 free Standard Slots. Each paid slot has its own access setting (slots added by other mods too). Without an economy you can still use Free or Unlock Card. Buying and renting can be turned on or off separately.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_NoEcon_hint: Minidoracat Economy not detected: slots set to Economy use unlock cards for now. When Economy is back they switch back automatically, along with their buy and rent settings.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Renewal_desc: When a rental ends, modules in that slot stop at once. For players with auto-renew on, it retries the charge every hour for the time below and turns the slot back on once paid.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_FullHours_de: Real time, 1 to 720 hours (30 days). How long a new battery lasts with only the minimap on.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Drains_desc: Extra drain on top of the minimap alone, 0 to 1000%%. Several modules add up: +25%% plus +10%% means 1.35x drain. The Power-Saver Core halves the whole watch's drain and isn't set here.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_DrainsNone: No modules from other mods right now.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_LootStyles: Watch styles that appear as loot
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_LootStyles_d: Unchecked styles won't appear in containers. Zombie drop rules are set separately.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_LootModules_: General modules are more common; Advanced and Core modules are rare.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_LootCards_de: Turn off when you sell slots through the economy, so players can't open them for free.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Craft_desc: Made from vanilla parts with a table next to you. Set the Electrical level it needs on the right (0 = none).
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Tool_desc: On by default, matching how vanilla handles installing and removing electronic parts. When off, modules can be installed and removed right from the watch panel.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_DropsOn_desc: When a corpse is searched for the first time, items are added following the rules below. Corpses that were already searched are not affected.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_DropCap_desc: When several rules match, chances are rolled in order and stop once this many items dropped.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_PickNone: None selected: check rules to change their chance or delete them all at once
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_BatchBad: The batch value must be a number of 0 or more.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_RulesEmpty: No drop rules yet: press "Add Rule", or restore the default rules.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Outfits_ph: Outfit names, comma-separated, e.g. HazardSuit, Bandit
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_NeedReason: Please enter a reason: it is written to the server log.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Invalid: Some fields have invalid values (red outline). Fix them before applying.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Note_FullHou: remaining time on every map watch scales to match
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Note_rule_mo: players without the matching module can't use it
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Diff_PriceWa: Rent, currency or period changed: auto-renew is paused for players who had it on, and they must accept again before they're charged.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Denied: You don't have permission to change server settings.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Conflict: Another admin just changed the settings. The current settings were reloaded and your changes were not applied.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_WriteFailed: Couldn't write the server settings file, so nothing was applied.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_EditHint: Click a rule in the list to edit it here; click the box on its left to select it.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Status_NoBatteryNe: No battery needed: the watch never runs out
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Foot_NoBatteryNeed: No battery needed: the watch never runs out.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Banner_NoBattery_M: No battery: the minimap still works, but other features and all modules are stopped. Insert a battery to restore them.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Banner_Dead_Map: Battery dead: the minimap still works, but other features and all modules are stopped. Insert a battery to restore them.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayReason_CARD_UNL: You already opened this slot with an unlock card, so there's nothing to pay.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_PayCardAlso: You can also open it with a %1: permanent and bound to your account.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Sum_NoBatter: Battery: not needed, the watch never runs out
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_NeedBattery_: With "Needs a battery" off, the watch never runs out: no drain, no charging, and no battery needed. "When the battery is dead" covers a dead or missing battery: turn every feature off, or keep only the minimap.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Charge_desc: By default batteries can only be swapped. When enabled, a worn watch slowly charges in real time: in a vehicle while the engine is running, and in a building while the spot has grid or generator power.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Range: Must be a whole number from %1 to %2
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Outfits_bad: Outfit names: letters, digits, _ and - only, separated by commas
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Tip_ChargingCar: Charging in the car: %1%%, full in about %2
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Tip_ChargingHouse: Charging in a powered building: %1%%, full in about %2
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Toast_Dead_msg: All features and modules have stopped. Insert a battery to restore them.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Toast_Dead_map: The minimap still works, but other features and all modules have stopped. Insert a battery to restore them.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Toast_Dead_light: %1 The light module's light went out too.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Toast_Charging_car: Charging in a car with the engine running. It stops when the engine is off or you get out.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Toast_Charging_hou: Charging in a powered building. It stops when you go outside or the power goes out.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Toast_Lapsed_msg: The %1 is disabled but still on the watch. It comes back as soon as you renew.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Toast_Lapsed_empty: You can't install a module in this slot until you renew.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Toast_Paused_msg: The %1 stopped working. The module is still on the watch; you can remove it and install it in another working slot.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Sound_Volume_toolt: Volume for installing or removing modules, the light switch, low battery, dead battery, rental ending and the scan ping. Only you can hear them; at 0%% they don't play.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Sound_ScanPing_too: Plays a short ping when the minimap rescans zombie dots or vehicles and animals (once if both update together). Only plays when the server uses scheduled scans; live updates (the default) don't ping. Your watch must be able to use that feature.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Sound_ScanPing_old: Needs a newer Minidoracat MiniMap: this version won't play the ping.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_ShowButton_tooltip: An on-screen button that opens or closes the Map Watch panel on click. It sits in the family toolbar. When hidden, right-click the map watch in your inventory and choose "Open Map Watch" to open the panel.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_Shop_desc: Put map watches, modules and batteries up for sale in the Economy Center so players can buy them. This opens the Economy Center shop page with a draft for each item it doesn't sell yet; you set the prices, and nothing goes on sale until you apply.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_ShopOldEcon: Update Economy: this version can't take items from other mods yet.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_ShopForbidde: You don't have Economy Center admin access.
IGUI_MinidoracatWatch_Admin_ShopFailed: Couldn't open the Economy Center shop page.
